notes: Compliance research summary, not legal advice (14 November 2026). Rows are representative rule combinations, not all 375 purpose/channel/sender/recipient permutations; “any” applies only within the conditions stated. “Fact verification” via transparency law concerns existing documented information, not a duty to confirm or deny new assertions. Article 8 political petitions are reserved to citizens; this does not make every policy email a formal petition. Article 33 is broad but does not precisely classify every foreign organization’s neutral inquiry. For automated and bulk email/phone/social outreach, the [private-sector data law](https://www.diputados.gob.mx/LeyesBiblio/pdf/LFPDPPP.pdf) arts. 5, 9, 15–16, 28–30 remains relevant; publicly listed data need not always require consent (art. 9(II)), but other privacy duties continue. The [consumer law](https://www.diputados.gob.mx/LeyesBiblio/pdf/LFPC.pdf) art. 18 Bis covers consumer advertising opt-outs, not all issue advocacy or a general email-spam prohibition. A direct message is not necessarily public dissemination under the [electoral blackout rule](https://www.diputados.gob.mx/LeyesBiblio/pdf/LGIPE.pdf) art. 251(4); context determines applicability.

notes: Compliance research summary, not legal advice; position as of 2026-11-14. Rows are representative rule-bearing combinations, not the 5×5×5×3 Cartesian product; “any” means the stated rule applies across that axis, not that every possible conduct is permitted. The 2023 personal-data bill is listed as draft; do not treat its proposed consent provisions as law. Publishing an official work address does not itself establish consent to mass marketing; no general statutory ban on use of all published official contact details was established. No general federal lobbyist-registration statute was verified; parliamentary survey data is internally inconsistent about accredited-lobbyist registers. Foreign NGO project/MoU terms must be checked individually. Election-specific ECP codes and provincial statutes can impose further restrictions.
